facts.activity_file: monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents
selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of TK-8311

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-8311 and LT-8311 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents on TK-8311 and LT-8311 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure. TK-8311 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 15 May 2019 a potential incident was recorded on TK-8311 and LT-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
